learner_operation: Construct the augmented matrix, eliminate above the third and second pivots, and identify its unique RREF or ordered solution.

fixed_features.feature: Upper triangular full-rank 3x3 system with unit pivots, integer arithmetic, variables x/y/z
fixed_features.justification: Target knowledge point assesses backward elimination rather than forward elimination or singular systems. Unit pivots keep the two/three-row-addition easy practice workload observed in every source practice case.

fixed_features.feature: One five-choice radio field for practice; fieldless canonical replay excluded from sampling
fixed_features.justification: Exactly one candidate solves the nonsingular system. Preserve complete captured practice banks and do not invent an uncaptured canonical bank.

answer_roles.role: Which candidate triple solves the system
answer_roles.eligible_variation: Any of five distinct candidates can be correct when RHS is derived from that candidate.
answer_roles.observed: All five tested roles in each restored profile and one prior profile per response shape; all survive filtering.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: All three nonzero, or each one individually absent, with signed coefficients.
answer_roles.observed: Four declared masks in each of five controlled profiles; independent visible row-operation validation.

coverage.case: Restored source replay and preserved complete banks
coverage.result: 15 captured cases replay, all 14 practice banks match all 70 original choices, canonical has no invented bank; all captured operative solution stages match.

coverage.case: Within-profile answer roles and elimination masks
coverage.result: 25 controlled semantic records across five profiles, five different solutions and four masks per profile; all survive shared delivery. Existing variation methods were retained.
Five seeded records repeat exactly after relocation with only declared runtime files.

counterfactuals.change: Hold coefficients, bank and seed fixed; change correct candidate role from 0 to 1 and recompute RHS.
counterfactuals.expected: Displayed RHS, final RREF, explanation and accepted candidate change together.
counterfactuals.observed: Three response-shape pairs pass independent visible mathematics and actual native all-choice grading. Representative matrix/text pairs and vector representation rendered in the unmodified UI.
counterfactuals.justification: A different RHS determines a different unique solution; the source candidate identity has no instructional privilege.

counterfactuals.change: Negate above-pivot coefficients while retaining the selected solution; recompute RHS.
counterfactuals.expected: Final correct triple remains unchanged while equations, row operations and intermediates change.
counterfactuals.observed: Three response-shape pairs pass independent visible mathematics and actual native all-choice grading. Representative matrix/text pairs and vector representation rendered in the unmodified UI.
counterfactuals.justification: Different nonsingular triangular systems can share one solution; equation representation is irrelevant to the final candidate value.
